---
protocol: fixture
title: Deliberate STE violations
---

<SteDescription>
The server doesn't keep the key.

The facilitator checks the signature; the server sends the response.

The server may return status 402 when the payment is missing.

The client reads the payment channel settlement batch proof.

The facilitator is sending the transaction to the chain.

The payment is settled by the facilitator.

The client sends one request to the server and the server answers with a status code and a header that lists every payment option that it accepts today.

One. Two. Three. Four. Five. Six. Seven.
</SteDescription>

<SteProcedure title="Violations in a procedure">

1. The client sends the request to the server.
2. The header is read by the client.
3. Start signing the payload.
4. Set up the wallet.
5. Send the request to the server and then wait for the response before you read all of the headers again now.

</SteProcedure>

<SteNote>
NOTE: The server returns status 402 if the payment is missing.
</SteNote>

<SteTerms>
- **facilitator**: The service that checks and settles a payment for the server.
</SteTerms>
